# Watobot

> Watobot lets you send WhatsApp messages programmatically from your own personal WhatsApp number — no WhatsApp Business API (WABA), no Meta business verification, and no message template approval process required.

Watobot links to your existing WhatsApp account the same way WhatsApp Web does (scan a QR code from a linked-devices flow), then exposes a REST API and a scheduling dashboard for sending messages — to individual contacts or WhatsApp groups — programmatically or on a recurring schedule. Every connection routes through a dedicated residential IP address near the user's real location to avoid WhatsApp's shared-server/bot detection, and per-user WhatsApp session data is encrypted client-side with a token that never leaves the browser, so the server operators cannot read it. The service is free, with no credit card required.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://watobot.xyz/): overview, features (remote API access, scheduled recurring messages, delivery logs, residential-IP ban protection), and pricing (free)
- [Privacy Policy](https://watobot.xyz/privacy.html)

## Free tools

- [WhatsApp Group FAQ Generator](https://watobot.xyz/whatsapp-group-faq/): upload a WhatsApp group chat export and get an AI-generated, editable, publishable public FAQ page in minutes — no signup required to try it
- [Scheduled & Recurring WhatsApp Messages](https://watobot.xyz/free-whatsapp-recurring-messages.html): schedule one-time or recurring (daily/weekly/monthly) WhatsApp messages to a contact or group
- [Calendly WhatsApp Integration](https://watobot.xyz/free-calendly-whatsapp-integration.html): connect Calendly and automatically send a WhatsApp message to every person who books a meeting — works on Calendly's free plan, unlike Zapier/Integrately/Pabbly which require Calendly's paid Standard plan for their webhook-based triggers

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/pocha/mudbot): full source code, including how the client-side data encryption model works
